t: A home storage server kit with four slots for fast SSDs.
steps: Buy the NAS Kit from the FriendlyElec shop. Add the case with a cooling fan.
Get a 12 V power supply with a 5.5 by 2.1 mm plug.
Pick NVMe SSDs and check them against FriendlyElec's warning list.
Download the OpenMediaVault image from the FriendlyElec CM3588 wiki.
Write the image to a microSD card and flash it to the onboard eMMC.
Plug in Ethernet, power on, and open the OpenMediaVault web page from your computer.
Create a shared folder and copy your first files over the network.
meta: Open Board. From $184. A few stores.
